name: document-systems
description: Compose, validate, audit, and render content-addressed document-system proposals without persisting or accepting them.

interface.shortDescription: Governed document models, validation, and views
interface.longDescription: Build immutable proposal Expressions from four bounded document profiles, validate structural and evidence boundaries, and render traceable stakeholder views. The plugin writes nothing and cannot make a document operative or accepted.
defaultPrompt: Model this document need as a proposal-scoped Expression.
Audit this Expression's integrity, lineage, and evidence boundaries.
Render a human-review or human-action view from this Expression.
